name: @gleanwise/client

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2022 --sourcemap --outfile=dist/index.js && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/schema.d.ts dist/schema.d.ts
